name: dart-foundation
description: Shared Dart foundation skills for the SDLC marketplace: dart-conventions (Dart 3 null safety, records, patterns, sealed and class modifiers, async discipline, Effective Dart), dart-tooling (pubspec constraints, pub workspaces, analysis_options + lints, format/analyze/fix, build_runner) and dart-testing (package:test, mocktail, async and stream matchers, coverage). Referenced by dart-plugin and flutter-plugin. No agent, no stack profile — pure shared library.
